B1 has discriminant −1 giving 27 ordinary tangents plus one hyperflex and contact Frobenius cycles 1^1 2^9 6^6; B2 restrictions are fourth powers, all 28 hyperflexes and cycles 1^4 4^6. Smoothness ensures distinct tangents cannot share contact points.
